services.desc: EXPERIENCE SOUTHEAST ALASKA'S AMAZING SEA AND SHORE Rates Private Charter: $1400 for 6 people Additional people $200each, up to 11 people Duration Approx: 4 hours About Meet captain Winston aboard our Motor Vessel the Athena Rose for a truly Alaskan experience on the water. You'll set out to explore the islands around Auke Bay north of Juneau, Alaska, surrounded by pristine mountain views. Keep an eye out for an abundance of wildlife found in these waters - eagles soaring, humpbacks breaching or seals and sea lions playing!
